 The new Spectral Green colour is exclusive to the top-spec TFT variant. 1 min read • 9 Nov '26 Vishal Venugopal Last month, we reported that the TVS Ntorq 150 had been spotted at a dealership in a new green colourway. The colour has now been added to the official website. It’s called Spectral Green and is exclusive to the TFT variant.
 No mechanical changes  
 Price unchanged at Rs 1.22 lakh 
 149.7cc single-cylinder engine makes 13.2hp and 14.2Nm

 Join Discussion The new colour takes the total number of options for the TFT variant to four
 With the addition of Spectral Green, the Ntorq 150 TFT is now available in four colour options, the others being Nitro Green, Racing Red and Turbo Blue. The new shade is the most understated of the lot, featuring a dark olive green as its primary colour, with bright yellow highlights on the front mudguard and tail section. It is also the only colour option to get black wheels, while the other three feature brighter primary colours and matching coloured wheels. If you prefer a more subtle colourway, this Spectral Green is arguably the pick of the range.
 Mechanically, nothing has changed. The Ntorq 150 continues to be powered by a 149.7cc single-cylinder air-cooled engine producing 13.2hp and 14.2Nm. The TFT variant gets a 5-inch colour TFT display and is priced at Rs 1.22 lakh, while the standard variant costs Rs 1.13 lakh.
